snippet.title: Asterfel - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for Asterfel, an upcoming dark fantasy action RPG developed by Mysteria Studio. Players will awaken on Asterfel after a shipwreck leads them to the island of greed, fractured alliances, and supernatural forces. Align with different factions for specific rewards, explore a plethora of landscapes from forgotten ruins to dense jungles, and take on enemies in search of forgotten secrets. Asterfel is coming soon to PC (Steam).
